blocks.text: ДО ЗАПИСИ. Открой https://www.skool.com/salesforce-automation-mastery-2005/classroom/eeba9845?md=aa596db9260040f68612cfe5a85a58a4 и специальную Agentforce Employee training org. Проверь prerequisite предыдущей главы. Записывай фактический Builder и реальные synthetic records. При отсутствии функции запиши схему и явно скажи, что live проверка не выполнена. ГОТОВЫЕ ВСТАВКИ: https://sam-portal-production.up.railway.app/animations/agentforce.mp4. Анимацию используй как отдельное пояснение; UI показывай реальным снимком.

Build an automation that accepts only a slot returned by the catalog and creates a controlled record. A Flow is a sequence of Salesforce operations and decisions. An Autolaunched Flow runs without an input screen: the agent supplies values and receives outputs. This Flow validates the customer, reloads the slot catalog, and creates the Test Drive. Validation belongs inside the automation, so a model-invented key cannot become an arbitrary appointment date. The unique Booking Key remains the final duplicate barrier in this teaching model.

Setup → Flows → New Flow → Autolaunched Flow (No Trigger). Label it SAM Book Demo Test Drive, API SAM_Book_Demo_Test_Drive. Add Text input variables model, slotKey, contactId with Available for input. Add Text outputs resultCode, resultMessage, testDriveId with Available for output. Add an internal Date/Time selectedStart. Keep user-context execution; do not select System Context Without Sharing.

ПРИ ЗАПИСИ · Create the Flow and variables. Выполни этот шаг в учебной org по открытому уроку. Покажи конкретный input, изменяемую настройку или узел Flow и наблюдаемый output. На сборку поставь CameraCue на паузу ⌘⇧Space. Не снимай токены и auth-файлы. До изменения состояния сохрани before evidence, после — persisted record/trace. Если это подготовка permission/activation, используй только уже разрешённую учебную конфигурацию; доступ к чувствительным системам не расширяй ради съёмки.
Check the value on screen before moving to the next step. If the result differs from the lesson, stop here and investigate that difference.

Get Records: Contact where Id equals contactId, storing the first record's Id. A Decision sends no-match to an Assignment setting resultCode=INVALID_CUSTOMER and a useful message, then ends. Continue only when the user can retrieve the Contact. Do not bypass missing access.

Add the SAM Demo Slot Catalog Apex action with model from the input. Store its outputs. A Decision requires resultCode=OK; otherwise return its result without creating records. A second Decision compares slotKey to slotOneKey or slotTwoKey and assigns the corresponding start to selectedStart. The default path returns INVALID_SLOT. Use the action's vehicleId and datetime, not a separate date invented by the agent.

Get Test_Drive__c where Booking_Key__c equals slotKey. If a visible record exists with the same Customer__c and Confirmed status, return its Id and ALREADY_BOOKED. If it exists for another customer or state, return SLOT_TAKEN without disclosing another customer's details. If no visible record exists, continue; the unique constraint still prevents a duplicate hidden record.

Create one Test_Drive__c with Vehicle__c from the action, Customer__c=contactId, Scheduled_At__c=selectedStart, Status__c=Confirmed, Duration_Minutes__c=30, and Booking_Key__c=slotKey. Store its Id in testDriveId. Set resultCode=CREATED and a message describing the created demo record. Retrieve it by Id if you also want its automatic Name.

For fallible actions and record operations, connect faults to an Assignment returning FAILED and a safe message such as: 'Booking could not be completed. Check existing bookings and permissions before retrying.' Do not display unrestricted $Flow.FaultMessage in the conversation. Investigate detailed errors through Flow debugging or failed interviews. A fault must not lead to a success response.

Save and Debug. Obtain an actual key from a temporary catalog-only Flow Debug run or the read action when configured. Pass City EV, that key, and Irina's real synthetic Contact ID. For a persisted demo, understand and disable Debug rollback only for your synthetic run. Verify the saved record. Repeat the same values: expect ALREADY_BOOKED and the same Id. A made-up key must produce INVALID_SLOT.

Activate after Debug and record inspection pass, then grant run access through SAM Agentforce Demo. Deleting your own demo record releases its unique key; cancelling it retains the key in this simplified version. A slot obtained before midnight may fail revalidation after the date changes. Cancellation, rescheduling, and real calendar behavior are explicit future extensions.

Free text cannot select an arbitrary date. A repeat returns the existing record or a clear conflict. An error is never described as a successful reservation. The Flow creates one record and returns the existing result for a legitimate repeat.
ПРИ ЗАПИСИ. Пауза для ответа. Покажи один из common failures и нужный диагностический экран.
A common mistake to avoid is this: Connecting Create Records to the default invalid-input branch. Keep the record or trace that supports your conclusion before continuing.
